title: Centrally located cozy 2 bd apt near Marathon Vlg!
description:
Welcome to our affordable 2-bedroom apartment in the heart of Nashville, TN, near Marathon Village! Enjoy the convenience of a dedicated parking space in a gated community, with free street parking available for additional vehicles. Our cozy & comfortable space is perfect for families, friends, or business travelers. Just minutes away from vibrant attractions, dining, and entertainment, this centrally located gem offers the ideal base for your Nashville adventures. Book now for a memorable stay!

The space
Welcome to our affordable 2-bedroom apartment, perfectly situated in the heart of Nashville, TN, just a stone's throw away from Marathon Village. This centrally located gem offers the ideal base for exploring the vibrant culture, music scene, and attractions that Nashville has to offer.

Our apartment is located in a gated community, providing you with peace of mind and security during your stay. You'll have a dedicated parking space for one car, and for any additional vehicles, there is free street parking available.

The apartment features two comfortable bedrooms, each designed with your comfort in mind. The living area is cozy and inviting, perfect for relaxing after a day of sightseeing or business meetings. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you need to prepare meals, making it a great option for both short and extended stays.

Our location provides the unique advantage of being close to downtown while remaining budget-friendly for our guests. Situated in an up-and-coming area just minutes from vibrant Broadway, our property offers both convenience and affordability.

Nashville, like many larger cities, boasts a diverse population within its downtown, and our neighborhood reflects this diversity. It's a dynamic experience, somewhat similar to the lively atmosphere one might encounter while visiting a larger city. 

Our goal is to ensure that everyone has a safe, positive and enjoyable time while staying with us in Music City. Our team is available throughout your stay should you have any questions or feedback.

Guest access
Entire home

Other things to note
Please note that this is a second-story unit.
